name: @andrewpopov/lane-broker
description: Machine-wide test-lane coordinator: serializes conflicting test lanes, caps concurrent heavy lanes, and refuses to start new work while the machine is overloaded.
author: Andrew Popov

scripts.lint: node --check bin/lane.js && node --check bin/lane-store.js && for f in ops/runner/*.js src/*.js src/store/*.js src/agent/*.js scripts/*.sh bosun/*.sh; do case "$f" in bosun/*.sh) bash -n "$f" || exit 1 ;; *.sh) sh -n "$f" || exit 1 ;; *) node --check "$f" || exit 1 ;; esac; done
